text.arabic_uthmani: حُنَفَآءَ لِلَّهِ غَيْرَ مُشْرِكِينَ بِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا خَرَّ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَخْطَفُهُ ٱلطَّيْرُ أَوْ تَهْوِى بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِى مَكَانٍۢ سَحِيقٍۢ

words.gloss_range: circumstantial plural state of God-directed exclusive inclination, defined positively by orientation and negatively against association
words.root_gloss_range: inclination or bending that becomes the Quranic quality of single-directed devotion; local grammar presents it as a settled state, not a new verb of inclining
words.prose: {{ar:حُنَفَآءَ}} ({{tr:ḥunafāʾa}}) opens the ayah as a carried state: the addressed community is to stand in a God-directed posture, not merely perform a fresh action. Its inclination is immediately sharpened against partnership, so the reader hears one-directional devotion before the warning names the opposite act. The root's bending pressure survives as a paradox: turning away from rival directions becomes true alignment.

topics.headline: carried state of orientation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with an ongoing posture carried from the prior commands, not with a detached label.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as an accusative circumstantial plural qualified by the following dedication and exclusion.

topics.headline: single tilt against partnership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that devotion is defined by both a single direction toward God and a refusal of distributed partnership.
topics.reason: The local phrase places the ḥ-n-f quality directly before the exclusion of the sh-r-k class and later repeats sh-r-k as the warning trigger.

topics.headline: bent root as settled quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the root's concrete bending pressure survives as a paradox of turning away from rivals into true alignment.
topics.reason: The root pressure is useful, but the local form is adjectival and circumstantial, so it should not be recast as an active verb.

words.gloss_range: preposition of dedication and direction that fastens the opening inclination to God
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) keeps the opening posture from floating. It makes the inclination immediately for and toward God, so dedication is heard before the phrase turns to negating partnership. As a bound preposition fused into the divine-name phrase, the dedication is grammatically attached to its endpoint rather than left detachable.

topics.headline: dedication endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle supplies the target of the posture before any negative exclusion appears.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the divine name and completes the opening state as a dedication phrase.

topics.headline: bound into the divine name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears dedication as grammatically attached to the named endpoint rather than as a detachable idea.
topics.reason: The single-letter preposition is bound into the following divine-name phrase.

words.gloss_range: the named divine endpoint of the opening dedication, later repeated as the violated referent
words.root_gloss_range: divinity and worship-object field, with derivational dispute pressure around worship and refuge; locally selected as the proper divine name
words.prose: {{ar:لَّهِ}} ({{tr:llāhi}}) gives the opening inclination its named center. Because the same divine referent returns under another preposition later, the ayah turns on one stable name while human relation to that name changes from dedication to violation. Worship-object and refuge pressure remain inside the proper name, without turning it into a generic deity term.

topics.headline: named endpoint of devotion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the posture is aimed at the proper divine name, not at a generic religious object.
topics.reason: The divine name is genitive after the dedication preposition and functions as the endpoint of the opening state.

topics.headline: same name across relations
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks one divine center through dedication, pronoun reference, and later wrongful association.
topics.reason: The same divine referent appears in the opening dedication phrase, in the later explicit name, and in the pronoun of the exclusion phrase.

topics.headline: worship-name pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader retains the worship and refuge pressure of the name while local grammar keeps it as the proper divine name.
topics.reason: Derivational pressure may inform the name's weight, but the local form is the definite proper noun.

words.gloss_range: accusative exclusion term that makes the opening state other-than the associating class
words.root_gloss_range: otherness and change field; locally selected as an exclusion/qualifier in construct with the following participle
words.prose: {{ar:غَيْرَ}} ({{tr:ghayra}}) pivots the opening from positive direction to negative boundary. It does not merely say no; it builds the excluded class into the circumstantial description, so devotion is defined as other-than association. The root's change-and-otherness pressure makes that exclusion feel like an identity boundary, while the local construct keeps exclusion as the selected function.

topics.headline: second circumstantial boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negative boundary is simultaneous with the positive posture rather than a later afterthought.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence allow the word as a second circumstantial qualifier of the opening state.

topics.headline: other-than class built in
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the excluded associating identity is grammatically attached to the word of otherness.
topics.reason: The following active participle is the genitive complement, so the exclusion is phrase-built rather than free-floating.

topics.headline: otherness with change pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader retains the sense that becoming other than association is an identity boundary, while local grammar keeps the sense as exclusion.
topics.reason: The root field supports otherness and change pressure, but the local construct selects the exclusion function.

words.gloss_range: Form IV active-participle class of those who assign partners, excluded from the opening devotional state
words.root_gloss_range: sharing and partnership field; locally narrowed by theological association with God and by Form IV causative agency
words.prose: {{ar:مُشْرِكِينَ}} ({{tr:mushrikīna}}) names the excluded identity before the ayah tests the same root as an individual conditional act. The participle makes association a characterized class, while the Form IV shape keeps agency in view: the offense is assigning partnership, not mere generic sharing.

topics.headline: excluded active-participle class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening excludes a human class characterized by association, not only an abstract act.
topics.reason: The word is an active participle in the exclusion phrase governed by the preceding construct.

topics.headline: neutral sharing narrowed to divine association
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees ordinary partnership language narrowed into the theological act of assigning partners with God.
topics.reason: The root may mean sharing broadly, but the Form IV participle and the local association complement select the theological violation.

topics.headline: state becomes conditional act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks sh-r-k from an excluded status into the conditional verb that triggers the simile.
topics.reason: The same root appears here as a participle and later as the jussive verb in the protasis.

words.gloss_range: associative preposition with a divine pronoun, marking the referent with whom partnership is wrongly made
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) makes the excluded association relational: the pronoun points back to God while the preposition marks with whom the partnership is wrongly made. The same sound later returns with a different referent, turning violation into consequence by pronoun routing.

topics.headline: with-Him association complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun keeps God grammatically present without repeating the divine name.
topics.reason: The preposition governs a pronoun complement to the participle and the referent is the previously named divine name.

topics.headline: cause pronoun returns as consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same clitic sound shift from God as violated referent to the human as carried victim later in the ayah.
topics.reason: The first pronoun resumes God, while the later matching clitic resumes the conditional human object.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction moving from the described posture into a connected conditional warning
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) moves the ayah from state to warning without breaking the line of thought. The conjunction lets the conditional begin as a new clause, while still making it answer the posture just described. Its compact entry into the conditional makes the warning tighten quickly after the longer opening phrase.

topics.headline: state into condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from desired posture to consequence for violating it as connected discourse, not a topic reset.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces the conditional clause after the completed opening circumstantial phrase.

topics.headline: tight warning onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the warning tighten quickly after the longer opening phrase.
topics.reason: The short conjunction plus conditional particle forms a compact onset into the protasis.

words.gloss_range: unmarked conditional whoever, subject of the jussive verb and gateway to the catastrophe frame
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) universalizes the warning. It supplies the subject of the jussive verb and opens the condition whose answer becomes the extended falling image, so the catastrophe is tied to whoever fits the act.

topics.headline: whoever under condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning is not restricted to a named group but applies to any agent who enters the condition.
topics.reason: The particle governs the jussive protasis and carries no visible gender or number restriction.

topics.headline: gateway to apodosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the falling scene as the answer to a moral condition rather than as free-floating imagery.
topics.reason: The conditional subject is carried into the jussive verb and answered by the following result clause.

words.gloss_range: jussive Form IV act of assigning association with God, serving as the trigger before the simile
words.root_gloss_range: sharing and partnership field narrowed locally to causative theological association by Form IV and the following prepositional complement
words.prose: {{ar:يُشْرِكْ}} ({{tr:yushrik}}) turns the excluded identity into a conditional act. Its jussive mood makes the act dependent on whoever enters the condition, and its Form IV shape makes the offense active assignment of partnership before the simile opens.

topics.headline: jussive trigger before consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb is grammatically waiting for its consequence, so the falling image answers this condition.
topics.reason: The verb is jussive under the conditional particle and stands immediately before the result clause.

topics.headline: caused partnership with God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the root's ordinary sharing field is narrowed to assigning partners with God, not reciprocal partnership among equals.
topics.reason: The local Form IV verb takes a bi-governed divine complement, selecting theological association rather than generic sharing.

topics.headline: participle becomes event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same root from excluded status into the decisive event that launches the catastrophe.
topics.reason: The previous active participle and this finite verb share the root while changing category and discourse function.

words.gloss_range: association preposition completing the conditional verb with the divine name
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) completes the conditional act by naming the violated with-God relation. Under the sh-r-k verb it selects association, not instrumentality, so the wrong is not objectless or vague. It also closes the protasis before the result particle enters.

topics.headline: association complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wrong is grammatically a with-God relation, not a vague objectless act.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the divine name as the complement of the Form IV sh-r-k verb.

topics.headline: condition completed before result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the condition become complete just before the result particle turns it into consequence.
topics.reason: The prepositional complement finishes the protasis before the following result conjunction.

words.gloss_range: the explicit divine name as the governed locus of violated exclusivity in the conditional clause
words.root_gloss_range: divinity and worship-object field, locally selected as the proper divine name repeated at the violation point
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) is repeated where a pronoun could have sufficed, so the violation is re-centered on the named divine referent before the image begins. The shift from dedication-preposition to association-preposition makes the same name carry the ayah's reversal.

topics.headline: explicit violated referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine name is repeated at the point of violation, keeping the breach named rather than merely pronominal.
topics.reason: The name is genitive after the association preposition and completes the conditional verb.

topics.headline: same name, changed relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same divine name from proper dedication into wrongful association through a preposition shift.
topics.reason: The first divine-name phrase uses dedication, while the second uses association under the sh-r-k verb.

topics.headline: proper name with worship pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the name's worship-object weight at the violation point, while local grammar keeps the form as the proper divine name.
topics.reason: The derivational and cooccurrence pressures enrich the proper name but do not replace its local grammatical role.

words.gloss_range: result conjunction introducing the conditional answer and making the simile a consequence
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge from condition to consequence. It makes the coming likeness answer the act of association, and its short pulse begins the stepped motion that will repeat inside the simile.

topics.headline: result particle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the image is grammatically caused by the condition, not offered as a detached illustration.
topics.reason: QAC and clause evidence identify this as the result conjunction introducing the apodosis.

topics.headline: repeated consequence pulse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears consequence arrive in steps, first into likeness and then into snatching.
topics.reason: A later matching conjunction introduces the next event in the same consequence sequence.

words.gloss_range: compound similitude particle opening an event-shaped extended comparison
words.prose: {{ar:كَأَنَّمَا}} ({{tr:kaʾannamā}}) turns the consequence into an extended verbal scene. Because the compound licenses a verbal clause, the ayah does not compare shirk to a static noun but to a whole falling, snatching, or hurling catastrophe.

topics.headline: event-shaped simile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the comparison opens into events rather than a simple nominal likeness.
topics.reason: The compound particle neutralizes ordinary nominal governance and introduces a verbal complement.

topics.headline: whole scene under comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the following verbs as one source scene for the condition, not as separate decorative images.
topics.reason: The particle governs the interpretive frame for the fall and both alternative outcomes.

topics.headline: from law to visualization
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse turn from direct moral condition into vivid visualization.
topics.reason: The similitude particle stands at the hinge between the conditional clause and the visual consequence.

words.gloss_range: completed catastrophic falling from height, with the conditional actor becoming the falling body
words.root_gloss_range: falling, collapse, prostration, and rushing-sound field; locally selected as uncontrolled descent, with prostration pressure functioning as contrast
words.prose: {{ar:خَرَّ}} ({{tr:kharra}}) makes the simile begin with a completed plunge. The pro-dropped subject is the same whoever of the condition, so the theological act becomes a falling body; the root's prostration associations survive as an inversion of voluntary surrender into uncontrolled collapse.

topics.headline: completed plunge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fall is presented as already accomplished before the continuing consequences unfold.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect in the simile and precedes imperfect verbs for the aftermath.

topics.headline: whoever becomes falling body
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the conditional agent carried into the image without being renamed, now as the helpless falling subject.
topics.reason: The 3ms verb has no overt subject, and the simile routes it back to the conditional subject.

topics.headline: prostration root inverted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the fall-root's worship contexts in reverse: bodily lowering becomes disintegration rather than surrender.
topics.reason: The local sense is catastrophic falling, while recurrence in prostration contexts supplies a valid contrast rather than the selected meaning.

words.gloss_range: source and separation preposition marking the sky as the origin of the fall
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) measures the fall by its source. The particle marks separation from height rather than motion toward a destination, so the image begins with loss from the highest visible reference before any birds or wind appear.

topics.headline: fall from height
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fall is specified as separation from height, not just downward motion.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the sky noun as the source of the falling verb.

topics.headline: source named before agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the vertical loss before the birds or wind appear as destructive agents.
topics.reason: The source phrase follows the fall verb directly and precedes the two outcome branches.

words.gloss_range: definite sky as the known elevated source of the fall, not rain, naming, or plural heavens
words.root_gloss_range: height, sky, elevation, and naming-related dispute field; locally selected as concrete elevated sky under a source preposition
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَآءِ}} ({{tr:al-samāʾi}}) gives the fall a known height-source. The root's elevation pressure is locally selected as the concrete sky, while the expected stable landing on earth is withheld by the two destructive branches.

topics.headline: known sky as source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fall begins from the recognized elevated canopy, not from an unspecified height.
topics.reason: The noun is definite and genitive after the source preposition.

topics.headline: elevation over other branches
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the root's elevation field driving the image, while other branches such as naming or rain are not locally selected.
topics.reason: The construction of falling from this noun selects the elevated spatial sense.

topics.headline: height without stable landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sky starts both fate branches, while the expected earth-pair or stable landing never arrives.
topics.reason: The sky is the shared origin before the alternative outcomes, and no ordinary earth endpoint is named.

words.gloss_range: sequential conjunction making snatching immediately follow the fall within the simile
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) accelerates the first outcome. After the fall, it links the next verb as immediate sequence, so the scene moves from descent to seizure without a calm interval. As the second such short pulse, it marks another consequence-step inside the image.

topics.headline: fall then snatching
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how quickly the first destructive branch follows the initial fall.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces the snatching clause as a sequence after the fall.

topics.headline: second consequence pulse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated short particle mark another consequence-step inside the image.
topics.reason: This conjunction repeats the earlier result particle's short pulse inside the simile sequence.

words.gloss_range: imperfect snatching verb with attached object pronoun, making the conditional actor prey of the collective birds
words.root_gloss_range: swift violent seizure field; locally selected as rapid aerial snatching, with variant forms intensifying the same action rather than replacing it
words.prose: {{ar:تَخْطَفُهُ}} ({{tr:takhṭafuhu}}) makes the fallen person an object suffix seized by an outside agent. The imperfect form keeps the action vivid, and the rare seizure-root makes the first branch feel like sudden interception before any recovery or landing. Variant intensity and the clipped consonant texture make this verb a pressure point of intensified seizure, while the base reading remains Form I.

topics.headline: suffix as seized prey
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conditional actor is now a grammatical object, acted on by the birds.
topics.reason: The verb has a 3ms object suffix and agrees with the following collective subject.

topics.headline: instant violent seizure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the first fate as sudden snatching rather than ordinary taking.
topics.reason: The root profile is consistently seizure-oriented and locally follows the fall as the first branch outcome.

topics.headline: variant intensity and clipped sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can use the variant and sound pressure to sense the verb as a pressure point of intensified seizure, while the base reading remains Form I.
topics.reason: Variant forms intensify the snatching but do not replace the canonical local form.

words.gloss_range: definite collective bird-agent, acting as the first destructive branch after the fall
words.root_gloss_range: flying, bird, omen, and fate field; locally selected as concrete collective birds with fate-pressure retained as image color
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلطَّيْرُ}} ({{tr:al-ṭayru}}) makes the first fate animate and aerial. The collective noun acts as a single agent over the object suffix, while the root's omen and fate field lets the concrete birds feel like agents of a destiny overtaking the falling person.

topics.headline: collective birds as agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the birds hold agency while the human has been reduced to the seized object.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative as the subject of the snatching verb and functions as a collective.

topics.headline: known aerial class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sky domain itself become hostile through the known class of flying creatures.
topics.reason: The definite collective noun identifies a known aerial class acting in the domain from which the fall began.

topics.headline: bird and omen field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear fate-pressure in the bird root while keeping the local scene as literal birds within the simile.
topics.reason: The root field includes omen and fate uses, but the local noun is the concrete bird-agent.

words.gloss_range: disjunctive particle opening the second full fate-branch rather than softening the threat
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) forks the catastrophe. It does not make the warning milder; it makes the mode of destruction indeterminate, either animate snatching or wind-driven hurling into a remote endpoint.

topics.headline: second branch scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle opens a whole wind-to-place branch, not just a second verb.
topics.reason: The disjunction scopes over the wind verb, its object phrase, its subject, and the final endpoint phrase.

topics.headline: not softened, made uncertain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the terror of not knowing which destructive mode will overtake the falling person.
topics.reason: Both coordinated alternatives remain catastrophic outcomes inside the same simile frame.

words.gloss_range: wind-governed downward motion made transitive by the following pronoun phrase, with desire-pull pressure retained
words.root_gloss_range: falling, downward attraction, desire, air, and abyss field; locally selected as wind-driven descent affecting the human object
words.prose: {{ar:تَهْوِى}} ({{tr:tahwī}}) heads the second fate branch as wind-driven descent. The following pronoun phrase makes the fall affect the person, while the root's desire and abyss pressure lets downward motion feel like a misdirected pull, not merely transport.

topics.headline: second branch verbal head
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second branch shift from bird seizure to wind-driven descent toward an endpoint.
topics.reason: The verb agrees with the wind subject in the base reading and begins the second branch after the disjunction.

topics.headline: fall made to affect him
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees an intransitive fall-field turned into a carried-him-down construction.
topics.reason: The following bi-pronoun phrase supplies the affected human participant.

topics.headline: fall, desire, air, abyss
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears physical descent resonate with desire-like downward attraction while local grammar keeps wind motion as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The broader h-w-y field supports desire and abyss pressure, but the local verb is governed by the wind branch.

words.gloss_range: preposition with 3ms pronoun making the wind's motion affect the same conditional human
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) turns the wind verb toward the person. Its pronoun resumes the same conditional actor, now not as agent but as carried object, and the earlier matching clitic makes offense and consequence formally touch. Whether heard as withness or transitivizing affectedness, the person travels under the wind's force rather than acting for himself.

topics.headline: him carried by wind
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same human participant move from conditional actor to object carried by the wind.
topics.reason: The prepositional clitic supplies the affected pronoun governed with the wind verb.

topics.headline: with-Him becomes with-him
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the earlier relation with God return as the grammar by which the human is carried away.
topics.reason: The same clitic sound recurs with a changed antecedent and changed grammatical function.

topics.headline: withness and affectedness compressed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the person travel under the wind's force, whether the bāʾ is felt as accompaniment or transitivizing affectedness.
topics.reason: Both local readings keep the person affected by the wind rather than acting independently.

words.gloss_range: definite singular wind as the elemental second agent of the fate branch
words.root_gloss_range: wind, breath, spirit, relief, and invisible-force field; locally selected as destructive wind, with singular and variant evidence sharpening agency
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرِّيحُ}} ({{tr:al-rīḥu}}) balances the birds with an elemental agent. The singular definite wind acts on the person as subject of the verb, while the plural variant shows how the same branch could be heard as a distributed wind field. The root's breath and relief field is reversed into invisible destructive transport, and the wind remains an aerial force in the same domain from which the fall began rather than random weather.

topics.headline: wind as second subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second fate shift from animate predation to elemental force while human agency remains absent.
topics.reason: The wind is nominative as subject of the second branch verb and parallels the bird-agent branch.

topics.headline: focused destructive wind
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the base reading as a focused singular destructive force, while the plural variant shows a possible distributed wind field.
topics.reason: The local surface is singular definite, with plural qiraat evidence useful as contrast.

topics.headline: breath and relief reversed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels a root field of breath, spirit, and relief turned locally into destructive invisible motion.
topics.reason: The broader root pressure is valid, but the local noun is physical wind acting destructively.

topics.headline: aerial force in the fall domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the wind as an aerial force in the same domain from which the fall began, not random weather.
topics.reason: The cooccurrence and local image keep the wind tied to the sky/fall domain and destructive wind field.

words.gloss_range: endpoint/location preposition placing the wind-carried person into the final remote place
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) gives the wind branch a terminal place. After a motion verb it functions dynamically: not mere residence, but placement into the final remote container. The preposition opens the closing phrase before the rare adjective seals the destination.

topics.headline: into the endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition turns the wind's motion into arrival in a containing endpoint, not just motion toward one.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the place noun after the wind-driven motion verb.

topics.headline: opens the final landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the final phrase begin before the rare adjective seals the destination.
topics.reason: The preposition opens the final prepositional phrase that contains the noun and its adjective.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive place of endpoint, unspecified and prepared for the final remote adjective
words.root_gloss_range: being, existence, becoming, and place field; locally selected as a noun of place that spatializes the final state
words.prose: {{ar:مَكَانٍۢ}} ({{tr:makānin}}) gives the wind branch a destination, but not a known refuge. Its indefiniteness denies orientation, while its k-w-n place form turns the end of the fall into a localized state of being marked by remoteness. Against the same-surah place of the House (22:26), this endpoint reverses sacred place into remote place.

topics.headline: prepositional endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the image lands in a governed endpoint phrase rather than in an independent statement.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the final preposition and is modified by the closing adjective.

topics.headline: unspecified destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the loss of orientation because the destination is unnamed before it is described as remote.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite with tanwīn in the final endpoint phrase.

topics.headline: being-root localized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the broad being-root narrowed into a place where the person's final state is spatialized.
topics.reason: The local form is a noun of place, not a general being verb.

topics.headline: sacred place reversed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare the remote endpoint with the same-surah sacred place thread at 22:26.
topics.reason: The same surah uses place language for the House at 22:26, while this endpoint is indefinite and remote.

words.gloss_range: final genitive indefinite adjective qualifying the place as remote and crushingly annihilating
words.root_gloss_range: remoteness, crushing, grinding, and destruction field; locally assigned to the final place as an extreme adjective
words.prose: {{ar:سَحِيقٍۢ}} ({{tr:saḥīqin}}) seals the ayah by assigning annihilating distance to the place itself. Its agreement binds it to the endpoint, its rarity matches the extremity of the image, and its final position closes the movement from directed orientation into remote disintegration. The paired -in tanwīn cadence with the preceding place word binds unspecified place and remoteness into one terminal unit.

topics.headline: final adjective of place
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that remoteness and crushing force qualify the destination, not a separate blow or agent.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with the place noun in genitive indefiniteness.

topics.headline: distance and crushing fused
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the endpoint as distance that destroys, not merely faraway geography.
topics.reason: The root field supports both remoteness and crushing, and the local adjective assigns that pressure to the final place.

topics.headline: rare final word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a rare adjectival form bears the closing semantic weight of the whole scene.
topics.reason: The supplied occurrence evidence marks the adjectival form as unique, and the word closes the ayah.

topics.headline: opening orientation reversed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's arc move from directed devotion to an indefinite remote place sealed by paired tanwīn cadence.
topics.reason: The final adjective completes the indefinite endpoint phrase and contrasts with the opening orientation.

baseline_models.mechanism: A deliberate lean is assigned wholly to God: ghayr excludes an added share, while the repeated shirk construction names the prohibited division of worship.

activation_trace.role: The branch image of leaning toward a direction supplies active reorientation and functions as the posture governing the clause.
The worship-and-worshiped branch supplies the relation's divine endpoint and makes the lean an act of devotion rather than geometry.
The exclusion and negation branch supplies the boundary around the posture and functions to bar a contrary identity.
The ordinary sharing branch supplies division of one matter among claimants and functions as the relational mechanics behind association.
The God-association branch supplies the explicit cultic scope and confines the prohibited sharing to the divine relation.

changed_reading.before: Be sincere monotheists and do not associate partners with God.
changed_reading.after: Maintain a directional posture whose motion and worship terminate wholly in God, with no second claimant admitted into that relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَرَّ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَتَخْطَفُهُ الطَّيْرُ أَوْ تَهْوِي بِهِ الرِّيحُ فِي مَكَانٍ سَحِيقٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: The simile removes stable position and then divides the victim between two uncontrolled trajectories: rapid seizure by mobile creatures or wind-driven descent into remoteness.

activation_trace.role: The disturbed, sounding fall supplies the initial loss of support and functions as the irreversible transition into exposure.
The sky-as-overarching-height branch supplies the elevated origin and functions as the support zone from which the subject is severed.
The light, rapid seizure branch supplies abrupt dispossession and functions as one route by which the falling subject loses bodily integrity and agency.
The light flight branch supplies mobile airborne takers and functions as the multiplying agents of seizure.
The plunge toward an abyss branch supplies the second downward trajectory and functions as uncontrolled transport toward an endpoint.
The blowing-wind branch supplies an impersonal carrier and functions as force without a destination chosen by the carried subject.
The place and station branch supplies a terminal location and functions as the anti-station produced by displacement.
The distance and banishment branch supplies extreme remoteness and functions as the completed loss of relation to the starting center.

changed_reading.before: Association is compared to a fatal fall from the sky.
changed_reading.after: Association is modeled as loss of a holding center: position, agency, bodily coherence, and destination successively pass to competing external forces.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُشْرِكْ ... فَتَخْطَفُهُ ... أَوْ تَهْوِي بِهِ الرِّيحُ
baseline_models.mechanism: Form-distant branches permit an interior analogue: divided counsel removes the mind's single center, desire hollows direction, and a stronger current carries what rapid capture has not already taken.

activation_trace.role: The non-unitary or shared opinion branch supplies divided counsel and functions as the mental form of association.
The capture of reason branch supplies sudden cognitive dispossession and functions as the interior counterpart of avian seizure.
The empty air and hollow heart branch supplies loss of inner stability and functions as the medium through which the self is carried.
The inclination of desire branch supplies self-directed appetite and functions as a live alternative driver of the plunge.
The wind-as-force branch supplies overpowering momentum and functions as the dominance that replaces deliberate orientation.

changed_reading.before: The image describes external bodily destruction.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also diagrams cognitive and volitional dispersal: divided allegiance makes reason capturable and leaves desire or ambient force to choose the destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The worshiper on an edge settles only under benefit and reverses on his face under trial. That sequence distinguishes the Godward lean of hunafa from a conditional tilt poised to flip direction.

activation_trace.role: The directed lean supplies the focus posture and functions as the stable orientation being differentiated.
The branch image of inclining away from a direction supplies edge-instability and functions as the false counterpart to the Godward lean.
The turning of a thing from its face supplies reversal and functions as the transition from conditional worship to loss.
The direction and orientation branch supplies the face as vector and functions as the visible indicator that the worshiper's course has inverted.

structural_cues: 22:11 orders benefit, settling, trial, face-reversal, and loss as a conditional instability sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies edge, directional face, and reversal; I infer that conditional attachment is the arrow converting a lean into a fall. A live alternative is that 22:11 supplies a parallel apostasy scene without directly specifying hunafa.

changed_reading.before: Hunafa means simply turning toward God rather than partners.
changed_reading.after: Hunafa is a load-bearing orientation that survives changed conditions; shirk begins when the apparent lean remains an edge-balance capable of reversing with circumstance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, cosmic and ritual bodies lower themselves in coordinated devotion. The focus fall becomes an inverted lowering: refusal of single devotion does not prevent descent, but changes ordered prostration into uncontrolled collapse.

activation_trace.role: The fall branch, whose scope includes falling in prostration, supplies the ambiguous lowering and functions as the hinge between devotion and collapse.
The lowering and abasement branch supplies creation-wide submission and functions as the ordered cosmic alternative to the focus fall.
The bending and head-lowering branch supplies deliberate ritual descent and functions as a controlled bodily trajectory.
The lowering branch supplies prostration at the purified House and functions as descent organized around a center.
The commanded bend supplies chosen lowering and functions as the closing bodily answer to the earlier uncontrolled fall.
The commanded prostration supplies the surah's final ordered descent and functions as the route to preserved orientation.

structural_cues: 22:18 universalizes prostration; 22:26 locates bowing and prostration at the House; 22:77 repeats both as closing commands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated chosen lowering and a fall branch that includes prostration; I infer an anti-prostration reversal in the simile. The materially live alternative is a purely punitive fall with no parodic relation to sujud.

changed_reading.before: The associator is punished by falling.
changed_reading.after: Every body lowers somehow: Godward lowering is centered, deliberate, and repeatable, while divided devotion converts the same vertical grammar into centerless collapse.

context_deltas.mechanism: God holds the sky from falling, while the focus subject falls from that sky; the closing command to hold fast to God supplies the relational counterpart. Association is thus loss of the one hold that keeps a trajectory coherent.

activation_trace.role: The disturbed fall supplies the exposed subject and functions as the result whose missing restraint the context reveals.
The grasping and restraining branch supplies active preservation and functions as the counterforce to falling.
The overarching sky branch repeats the focus medium and functions as the exact object whose stability depends on divine holding.
The falling-and-settling branch supplies the prevented event and functions as the explicit inverse of the subject's fall.
The hold that prevents and preserves supplies relational attachment and functions as the human-side answer to divine restraint.

structural_cues: 22:65 makes sky-fall a divinely restrained possibility; 22:78 closes with holding fast to God and names Him patron and helper.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine restraint, prevented sky-fall, and commanded holding; I infer a two-sided holding relation whose abandonment exposes the focus subject. Alternatively, 22:65 may remain cosmological care rather than a direct model of shirk.

changed_reading.before: The person happens to fall from a high place.
changed_reading.after: The person falls out of a preserved relation: substitutes divide allegiance but cannot provide the single hold that keeps sky, self, and destination coherent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later fly simile miniaturizes the focus seizure: what is invoked besides God cannot retrieve even what a fly steals. The associator entrusts the self to claimants that cannot reverse the smallest airborne dispossession.

activation_trace.role: The light, rapid seizure branch supplies the focus dispossession and functions as the action mirrored at smaller scale.
The light airborne creature branch supplies the focus taker and functions as the large-scale counterpart to the fly.
The fly branch supplies the tiny airborne thief and functions as a scale-reversing test of the invoked powers.
The extraction-from-another's-grasp branch supplies rescue as the failed operation and functions as the missing reversal of seizure.
The weakness branch supplies incapacity in both seeker and sought and functions as the explanation for irretrievability.

structural_cues: 22:73 says the fly robs something from the invoked beings, they cannot recover it, and both seeker and sought are weak; the branchless س ل ب occurrence is used only as this structural cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies airborne theft, failed recovery, and reciprocal weakness; I infer that 22:73 exposes why no partner can rescue the snatched self of 22:31. An alternative is simple reuse of seizure imagery without identity between the two similes.

changed_reading.before: Birds are merely frightening agents in a punishment image.
changed_reading.after: The airborne seizure also tests alleged power: those invoked besides God cannot recover even a fly's spoil, much less reassemble or redirect the person surrendered to divided allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah relocates blindness to hearts, describes a distant split, and answers it with humbled hearts guided to a straight path. These cues stabilize the focus branches of captured reason and hollow desire as an interior fall.

activation_trace.role: The capture-of-reason branch supplies cognitive loss and functions as the focus anchor for the interior model.
The hollow heart and empty air branch supplies inner vacancy and functions as the medium of cognitive falling.
The heart branch supplies the faculty at issue and functions as the actual site of perception or blindness.
The reason that restrains ignorance supplies cognitive binding and functions as the coherence lost when reason is snatched.
The blindness of heart and insight branch supplies nonvisual blindness and functions as evidence that the fall can be epistemic.
The splitting of a group by disagreement supplies social-cognitive division and functions as the collective form of a divided center.
The distant tract branch supplies remoteness inside schism and functions as a verbal bridge to the focus endpoint.
The gentle direction toward the true road supplies restored guidance and functions as the counteraction to cognitive capture.
The straight road branch supplies coherent trajectory and functions as the alternative to wind-driven remoteness.

structural_cues: 22:46 contrasts seeing eyes with blind hearts; 22:53 moves from diseased or hard hearts to distant schism; 22:54 moves from recognition to faith, humbled hearts, and a straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heart-blindness, reason as restraint, distant schism, and restored guidance; I infer that the physical sequence externalizes an interior loss of integration. The alternative is that these are parallel moral consequences rather than the mechanism of the simile.

changed_reading.before: The fall concerns bodily exposure to birds and wind.
changed_reading.after: The fall can also stage the unbinding of reason: a blind or hollow heart divides into distant schism until external currents, rather than restrained insight, determine its path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah places one God beside multiple communities and rites, and presents night and day entering one another under God's action. Multiplicity and interrelation are therefore not themselves shirk; the prohibited share is elevation of another into God's unique divine claim.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary sharing branch supplies the broad relational possibility and functions as the reading that context must delimit.
The association-with-God branch supplies the narrower cultic violation and functions as the contextually selected scope.
The community-or-kind branch supplies legitimate human plurality and functions as the distributed subject of ritual.
The place and performance of rite branch supplies differentiated ritual forms and functions as plurality ordered toward one deity.
The branch of God's oneness without partner supplies the non-shareable center and functions as the limit on ritual plurality.
The entering of one thing into another supplies divinely governed interpenetration and functions as evidence that overlap need not be rivalry.
The repeated community branch supplies continuing plurality and functions as the social container for distinct rites.
The repeated rite branch supplies practiced ritual difference and functions as a non-idolatrous multiplicity explicitly made by God.

structural_cues: 22:34 moves from a rite for every community to 'your deity is one deity'; 22:67 again assigns each community a rite; 22:61 attributes mutual night-day entry to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one deity, many communities and rites, and governed interpenetration; I infer a scope restriction from generic sharing to rival divine entitlement. A live alternative is that the cosmological overlap of 22:61 is unrelated to the semantic boundary of shirk.

changed_reading.before: Non-association can sound like rejection of every shared, plural, or overlapping relation.
changed_reading.after: The ayah rejects rival divinity, not coordinated plurality: communities, rites, and interpenetrating created processes remain many while their source and divine endpoint remain one.

context_deltas.mechanism: A consecrated animal falls, becomes shared food, and does not bodily reach God; taqwa reaches Him. In the focus counterimage, misdirected dedication makes the dedicator fall and become airborne prey rather than a participant in ordered distribution.

activation_trace.role: The bodily fall supplies the focus descent and functions as the point compared with the consecrated animal's fall.
The rapid taking branch supplies predatory removal and functions as the disordered alternative to commanded eating and feeding.
The falling-and-occurring branch supplies the sacrificial body's fall and functions as a ritually contained counterpart to kharra.
The eating branch supplies authorized consumption and functions as one ordered destination for the fallen body's matter.
The feeding-another branch supplies social redistribution and functions as the opposite of seizure by competing takers.
The reaching and attaining branch supplies the denied bodily ascent and the affirmed attainment of taqwa, functioning as the vertical correction.
The protection-from-harm branch supplies taqwa's protective orientation and functions as what reaches God instead of flesh or blood.

structural_cues: 22:36 orders the fallen sacrificial body into eating and feeding; 22:37 denies that flesh or blood reaches God and affirms that taqwa does.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two bodily falls, predatory taking versus social distribution, and a correction of what reaches God; I infer an anti-sacrificial reversal in which false dedication makes the worshiper prey. The alternative is a vivid but accidental juxtaposition of independent ritual and warning images.

changed_reading.before: The focus victim is simply destroyed by animals or wind.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the victim becomes an anti-offering: correct dedication distributes a fallen body while taqwa rises, but divided dedication turns the dedicator into prey and sends the person, rather than piety, away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Deep routes can converge on the House, and all affairs return to God; mere distance is therefore not failure. The focus remote place is a pathologically centerless endpoint, sharpened by the surah's 'distant schism.'

activation_trace.role: The place and station branch supplies the terminal location and functions as the endpoint whose relation to a center is being tested.
The distance and banishment branch supplies remoteness and functions as failed arrival rather than neutral mileage.
The deep or distant road branch supplies great travel distance and functions as a successful convergent route toward the House.
The distant tract branch supplies remoteness within schism and functions as the moral-spatial analogue of the focus endpoint.
The return-to-what-was branch supplies universal return and functions as the convergent trajectory against which remote displacement is read.

structural_cues: 22:27 brings pilgrims from every deep pass toward a named center; 22:53 locates wrongdoers in distant schism; 22:76 says all affairs are returned to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deep but convergent travel, distant schism, and universal return; I infer that sahiq marks broken orientation rather than distance alone. The alternative is that the passages share only spatial vocabulary while the focus remains literal remoteness.

changed_reading.before: Sahiq intensifies the physical distance of the landing place.
changed_reading.after: Sahiq names nonreturning distance: a deep road remains viable when it has a center, whereas shirk produces remoteness whose trajectory no longer participates in conscious return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening quake destabilizes the shared world, while a later ruined village is destroyed and collapsed on its structures. The focus fall compresses that surah-wide collapse pattern into one exposed person.

activation_trace.role: The disturbed fall supplies personal collapse and functions as the small-scale instance of a larger destabilization pattern.
The disturbance and shaking branch supplies world-scale loss of stability and functions as the surah's opening scale for the focus fall.
The fall into destruction branch supplies communal extinction and functions as the historical-scale counterpart to the exposed individual.
The collapse and demolition branch supplies structures fallen upon themselves and functions as built-form disintegration parallel to bodily disintegration.

structural_cues: The whole-surah sequence opens with universal shaking, places the individual fall at 22:31, and later displays a village collapsed upon its roofs at 22:45.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collapse at cosmic, personal, and civic scales; I infer a scale-recursive mechanism in which loss of right relation destabilizes an integrated whole. The alternative is thematic recurrence without a shared causal model.

changed_reading.before: The focus simile is an isolated image of one person's punishment.
changed_reading.after: The person becomes a miniature ruined world: the same loss of integration that shakes a cosmos and hollows a settlement is rendered as one body losing support, unity, and place.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the foot-deformity branch of hanif rather than its familiar directional branch. It remains anchored in حُنَفَاءَ and gains local support from the immediately preceding pilgrimage by foot, on lean mounts, through open passes; downstream prose should present it only as an embodied branch-image overlay, not as the lexical replacement for hunafa.

activation_trace.role: The bent or turned foot branch supplies bodily asymmetry and functions as an image of orientation enacted through gait.
The intent toward what is magnified branch supplies pilgrimage as purposeful approach and functions as the gait's destination.
The walking-on-legs branch supplies pedestrian movement and functions as the immediate embodied cue for the foot image.
The gathered lightness after preparation branch supplies lean mounts shaped by travel and functions as a second non-idealized pilgrimage body.
The open pass between mountains supplies a traversable channel and functions as the terrain through which directed gait converges.

changed_reading.before: Hunafa is an abstract doctrinal orientation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, hunafa becomes a pilgrim gait: even a bent foot, lean body, or distant route can enact wholeness when every uneven step converges on God.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because السماء is plainly the sky in the focus while the activated branch concerns name and designation. It remains root-anchored through س م و and is repeatedly cued by 'the name of God' and 'He named you the submitters'; downstream prose should label it a form-distant lexical resonance, never a replacement of the physical sky.

activation_trace.role: The name-as-notice-and-indication branch supplies recognized designation and functions as a secondary resonance inside the surface sky.
The name branch is realized in God's name and functions as the first repeated naming cue around the focus.
The repeated name branch supplies ritual designation and functions as a God-centered identity marker across communities.
The name branch supplies consecrating speech over the sacrificial animals and functions as the verbal alignment of matter with God.
The name branch supplies public remembrance in protected worship places and functions as socially maintained recognition.
The naming branch supplies the designation 'submitters' and functions as the closing communal identity cue.

changed_reading.before: The associator falls physically from the sky.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, the associator also falls out of God-centered naming and recognizable submission, moving from a shared designation into remote anonymity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the birds and wind as a lesson in secondary causation rather than only as threats. It remains anchored in the grammatical agents of تَخْطَفُهُ الطَّيْرُ and تَهْوِي بِهِ الرِّيحُ and in يُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ, while the context supplies subjugated processes and selected messengers; downstream prose should state only that agency need not imply divinity, not that the birds or wind are messengers.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ ... تَخْطَفُهُ الطَّيْرُ ... تَهْوِي بِهِ الرِّيحُ

activation_trace.role: The association-with-God branch supplies the forbidden promotion and functions as the distinction that secondary agency must not cross.
The flying-creature branch supplies a real grammatical actor and functions as an example of effective but nondivine agency.
The blowing-wind branch supplies an impersonal effective force and functions as a second created agent.
The subjection and steering branch supplies created processes directed to a purpose and functions as the sovereignty frame for secondary action.
The affair or directive branch supplies action under God's command and functions as the ordering source behind effective means.
The selection of a chosen representative supplies delegated agency and functions as evidence that mediation need not divide divinity.
The messenger and message branch supplies authorized mediation and functions as the clearest contextual distinction between agent and partner.

changed_reading.before: The active birds and wind can sound like autonomous rival powers in the simile.
changed_reading.after: Their efficacy does not make them partners: the simile can preserve real created agency while reserving sovereignty and divinity for God alone.

strongest_changes: The Godward lean is distinguished from edge-worship that reverses under trial.
The fall is recast as inverted prostration: lowering is inevitable, but only God-centered lowering remains ordered.
God's holding of the sky and the command to hold fast expose missing restraint as the core of the fall.
The fly simile explains the irretrievability of the snatched subject by showing the weakness of every invoked substitute.
Legitimate communal and ritual plurality narrows shirk to rival divine entitlement rather than multiplicity itself.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly reversed the focus image rather than merely echoing it: stable leaning opposed edge-reversal, prostration opposed collapse, holding opposed falling, feeding opposed predation, convergent depth opposed remote nonreturn, and a tiny fly exposed the impotence of alleged partners. Form-distant branches also preserved two contained activations that conservative synthesis would likely lose: the pilgrim gait of hanif and the naming resonance inside sama.
remaining_uncertainties: The anti-prostration reading depends on treating the prostration scope of خ ر ر as active in this explicitly spatial fall.
The cognitive model relies on form-distant branches of خ ط ف and ه و ي and may be analogy rather than mechanism.
The anti-sacrificial reversal is structurally close to the focus but remains an inferred comparison, not an explicit equation.
The sky-as-naming and bent-foot pilgrimage readings should remain marked lexical resonances rather than surface translations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A corrective inclination versus fragmented vectors.** `ح ن ف B002` supplies inclination toward a side, while `ش ر ك B001/B002` divides allegiance through partnership. The initial inclination is explicitly “for God,” then opposed to association. I infer that *ḥunafāʾ* is a corrective lean toward the single center, whereas partnership exposes the self to competing directions. Upright devotion thus reads dynamically as purposeful reorientation.
2. **Association as loss of coherent trajectory.** `خ ر ر B001` is a rumbling fall, `خ ط ف B001` swift snatching, `ه و ي B002` falling into an abyss, `ر و ح B003` moving wind, and `س ح ق B002` driving far away. The simile offers two ungoverned outcomes after descent from the sky-cover (`س م و B004`). I infer that abandoning one divine orientation leaves the person to external vectors that dismember or disperse. Shirk reads as catastrophic loss of navigational integrity.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:62's paired Truth/void distinction retrospectively identified the fall's deepest cause: divided invocation lacks the sustaining efficacy that holds cosmic opposites in order.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Single orientation supplies an axis; partnership loses it.** Fixed `حُنَفَاء` activates `ح ن ف:B002` (inclination toward a side), whereas repeated `ش ر ك:B001` introduces divided partnership. The simile then stacks `خ ر ر:B001` (rumbling fall) from `س م و:B004` (overhead sky), `خ ط ف:B001` (swift snatching), `ط ي ر:B001` (airborne birds), `ه و ي:B002` (falling into an abyss), `ر و ح:B003` (wind), and `س ح ق:B002` (distance and driving far away). The packet supplies the opposed vectors; I infer that exclusive inclination stabilizes direction, while divided allegiance exposes the person to external forces. Association reads as loss of navigational agency, not only a doctrinal label.
2. **The two endings are distinct failure modes.** One body is captured by a living snatcher; the other is carried into remoteness by wind. I infer from the supplied alternatives that loss of the center can end either in appropriation by another agent or impersonal dispersal. The simile preserves both readings rather than merging them.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `22:32` supplies the missing positive axis after the fall: guarded hearts make ritual signs weighty. `22:36` then shows that axis ordering a powerful animal toward naming and feeding rather than dispersal.

baseline.text: Allah'a yönelen ve O'na ortak koşmayan kimseler olun. Kim Allah'a ortak koşarsa sanki gökten düşmüş de kendisini kuş kapmış veya rüzgâr onu uzak bir yere sürüklemiş gibidir.

findings.text: Yalnız Allah'a yöneliş kişiye bir eksen sağlarken ortak koşmak, yönü parçalayıp düşme ve sürüklenmeyle sonuçlanan dağınık kuvvetlere bırakır.
Kuşun kapması ile rüzgârın uzağa atması iki ayrı başarısızlığı gösterir: dış güççe ele geçirilme ve yönsüzce savrulma.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It names association with God as the cause of a far-reaching error, directly grounding the focus's dispersed, remote loss.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It frames following guidance as a feared seizure from one's land, a counterpoint to the focus's loss through association.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its warning that there is no god but God supports exclusive devotion but does not develop the fall or dispersal image.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ayağın veya bacağın özellikle içe doğru eğilmesini ve bunun farklı görünüşlerini açıkça anlatır. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu bedensel biçim özelliğini doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, genel yönelmeyi değil ayağa veya bacağa özgü kalıcı eğrilik ve dönüklük görünüşünü kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın biçimde adlandırılan ayak eğriliğini temel alır; kişi nitelemeleri ile ayağın eğrilmesini anlatan bağlı kullanım bu çekirdeğe ayrı gerçekleşmeler olarak bağlanır.

concept_map.definition: Ayağın, özellikle ön bölümünün, içe doğru eğri veya dönük olmasıdır. Kaynaklarda bu durum içe eğrilik, iki başparmağın birbirine yönelmesi ya da ayağın sırtını taban konumuna getirecek ölçüde dönmesi gibi değişik görünümlerle açıklanır.

facets.statement: Ayağın veya bacağın içe doğru eğri ya da dönük bir biçim alması temel anlamdır.
Bazı açıklamalar eğriliği özellikle ayağın ön bölümündeki içe yönelim olarak sınırlar.
İki ayağın başparmaklarının birbirine bakması, biçim özelliğinin gözlenebilir bir belirtisi olarak verilir.
Ayağın çok ileri derecede dönerek sırt bölümünün taban gibi alta gelmesi, durumun ağır bir görünümü olarak aktarılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, ayağın ya da bacağın içe doğru eğriliğidir; anlatımlar bunun yerini, başparmakların karşı karşıya gelişini ve ileri derecedeki dönmeyi farklı betimlemeler olarak sunar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ayağın veya bacağın içe doğru eğri ya da dönük biçimini, kaynaklardaki değişik görünüşleri dışlamadan adlandırır.

error_profile.preserves: Bedensel yeri, içe yönelimi ve biçimsel eğrilik çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bu görünüşü taşıyan bir kişiyi doğal bir cümle içinde nitelemek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişide bulunan ayak eğriliğini ve içe dönüklüğü açıkça belirtir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da düzgün biçimden ayrılan gözlenebilir bir eğrilik bulunur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda bir doğrultudan yana doğru eğilme bileşeni vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Birinci dal sabit bir ayak biçimine, komşu dal ise fiziksel ya da soyut yönelme ilişkisine dayanır; bedensel özellik komşu dalın çekirdeği değildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi genel eğilme ve bir şeye yönelmeyi destekler, ancak karşıt yönler arasındaki değişimi bağımsız ve zorunlu bir süreç olarak kurmaz. İyiden kötüye veya kötüden iyiye yönelme, genel çekirdeğin ahlaki alandaki örneğidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hem yalın eğilme çekirdeğini hem de bir şeye yönelmeyi kapsar; tamamlanmış dönüş veya geri dönüş zorunlu değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimin genel eğilme anlamı korunur; bir şeye doğru yönelmeyi bildiren bağlı yapı ayrı bir kullanım olarak gösterilir ve bütün dala amaçlı yönelme şartı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin bulunduğu doğrultudan bir yana eğilmesi veya başka bir yöne yönelmesidir. Bir şeye yönelme ve iyi ile kötü gibi karşıt değer alanlarından ötekine eğilim gösterme, bu genel çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Genel çekirdek, bir doğrultudan yana doğru eğilme veya yön değiştirme eğilimidir.
Belirli bir şeye doğru yönelme, bağlı yapıda açık bir hedef kazanan özel kullanımdır.
İyi ile kötü gibi karşıt değer alanları arasında bir yana eğilim gösterme, çekirdeğin soyut alana uzanmasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar genel eğilme çekirdeğinde birleşir; hedefe yönelme ile karşıt değer yönlerinden birine kayma bu çekirdeğin daha belirli ve soyut kullanımlarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem yalın doğrultu değişikliğini hem de açık bir hedefe doğru eğilim göstermeyi kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yana eğilme çekirdeğini ve hedefli yönelmeye açılan kapsamı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yönelmenin hedefi cümlede açıkça verildiğinde doğal karşılık olarak kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir hedefe doğru eğilim ve yöneliş bileşenini korur.
error_profile.loses: Açık hedefi bulunmayan yalın yana eğilme anlamını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Başlangıç doğrultusundan ayrılmanın öne çıktığı fiziksel veya soyut bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Var olan doğrultudan yana ayrılma bileşenini güçlü biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir hedefe olumlu biçimde yönelme kullanımını doğal olarak karşılamaz.

error_profile.preserves: Başka bir doğrultuya geçme düşüncesinin bir bölümünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Yalnızca eğilim veya yönelme halinde kalabilen çekirdeği siler.
error_profile.adds: Tamamlanmış bir yön değiştirme olayını zorunluymuş gibi ekler.
error_profile.collision: Geri dönme veya bütünüyle tersine dönme olayıyla karışabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeye yönelmeyi ve karşıt değer yönlerinden birine eğilim göstermeyi açıkça kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Merkezden yana sapmayı çok çeşitli nesnelere uygular ve bir şeyi eğme anlamını da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın çekirdeğinde düz veya önceki doğrultudan bir yana ayrılma vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Genel eğilme alanında büyük ölçüde örtüşürler; odak dal hedefe yönelme ve değer yönelimiyle belirginleşirken komşu dal nesne kapsamı ve ettirgen kullanımla genişler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İyi ile kötü gibi karşıt değer alanlarından birine yönelmeyi örnekleyebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gemi ve hayvan gibi taşıyıcıların yana yatmasını, ayrıca birine uyma ve boyun eğmeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da fiziksel veya soyut olarak bir yana ve bir hedefe yönelmeyi anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdekleri yakındır, fakat komşu dalın taşıt, hayvan, uyma ve boyun eğme kapsamı odak dalda kurucu değildir; odak dalın değerler arası yönelimi de komşu kartta belirtilmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yönelim tamamlanmadan yalnızca eğilim halinde bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Önceki bir ayrılıştan sonra geri gelmeyi veya bir karardan dönmeyi gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda önceki doğrultudan başka bir yöne geçiş düşünülebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yönelimin kendisini anlatır ve geri gelme koşulu taşımaz; komşu dalda önceki durumdan ayrılma ve ardından geri dönüş ya da açık karar değişikliği belirleyicidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Fiziksel veya soyut bir yöne doğru genel eğilim ve hedefe yönelme bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ayağın içe eğri veya dönük sabit biçimini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da içe ya da yana yönelme biçimindeki uzamsal tasarımı paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel bir yön ilişkisi kurar; komşu dal bu ilişkiyi ayağın bedensel biçimine özgüleştirir ve genel hedefe yönelmeyi kapsamaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü karşılaştırıldı; genel yana sapma, hedefe eğilme, geri dönüş ve ayağa özgü eğrilik en yararlı sınırları verdi. Yalnız yön veya hareket alanını paylaşan daha uzak adaylar elendi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yanlış sayılan inançtan ayrılıp doğru dine yönelen ve bu yolda kalan kişiyi anlatır. Verilen dal çerçevesi, bu yön değişimini ve ortaya çıkan doğru inanç bağlılığını güvenilir biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, genel dindarlığı değil sapkınlıktan doğru kabul edilen tek tanrılı inanç yoluna yönelişi ve bağlılığı anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dinî kişi ve yol anlamıyla sınırlıdır; başka dallardaki ayak eğriliği, genel yönelme veya belirli törenlere dayalı adlandırmalar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yanlış sayılan inanç yolundan ayrılıp doğru kabul edilen tek tanrılı dine yönelen ve ona bağlı kalan kişidir. Kaynaklar bu bağlılığı kutsal ibadet yönüne dönme, putlardan uzak durma ve kendini ibadete verme ile somutlaştırır.

facets.statement: Sapkınlık sayılan yoldan ayrılıp doğru kabul edilen inanca yönelmek temel anlamdır.
Doğru tek tanrılı inanç geleneğine bağlı kişi, yönelmenin ortaya çıkardığı dinî kimliği taşır.
Putlardan uzaklaşmak ve kendini ibadete vermek, bu inanç yöneliminin davranışsal görünümüdür.
Kutsal ibadet yönüne dönerek doğru inanç geleneğini izlemek, bağlılığın kaynaklarda verilen özel açıklamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, sapkınlıktan doğru inanca yönelmiş ve o yola bağlı kişidir; tek tanrılı gelenek, kutsal ibadet yönü, putlardan uzaklaşma ve ibadete adanma bu kimliğin açıklayıcı bileşenleridir.

concept_gloss.text: doğru tek tanrılı inanca yönelen kişi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Doğru kabul edilen tek tanrılı dine yönelmiş kişi kimliğini ve kalıcı bağlılığı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Fiziksel veya soyut herhangi bir yöne ve hedefe eğilmeyi din şartı olmadan kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yönelmeyi doğru inanç hedefi ve kişi kimliğiyle sınırlar; komşu dal ise dinî sonuç veya sürekli bağlılık gerektirmeyen genel bir yön ilişkisidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sapkınlıktan ayrılıp doğru kabul edilen inanç yoluna yönelmeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Doğru yoldan ve düzgün doğrultudan uzaklaşmayı anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar incelendi; genel yönelme dalı kapsam sınırını, doğru yoldan sapma dalı ise karşıt yönü en açık biçimde gösterdi. Yalnız yön, yol veya dinî sahne ortaklığı bulunan öteki adaylar çıkarıldı.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الحنيف المائل إلى الدين المستقيم (maqayis); الحنيف المسلم الذي يستقبل قبلة البيت الحرام على ملة إبراهيم (ayn;tahdhib); الحنيف العادل عن دين إلى دين وبه سميت الحنيفية (jamhara); الحنيف المسلم وقد سمي المستقيم بذلك (sihah); اعتزل الأصنام وتعبد (sihah); الحنف ميل عن الضلال إلى الاستقامة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi törenlerin kendisine verilen bir adı değil, kutsal ziyareti yapan veya dinsel kesim töreninden geçen kişiye verilen nitelemeyi anlatır. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, ancak tanım geçici 'törenler' çerçevesini kişi merkezli olarak düzeltmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, genel dinî kimliği değil belirtilen törenlerden biri nedeniyle kişiye uygulanan tarihsel nitelemeyi kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın kişi nitelemesi tanımlanır, fakat anlam belirtilen kutsal ziyaret veya dinsel kesim töreni şartına bağlı tutulur; genel dinî yönelme dalına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kutsal evi ziyaret etme ibadetini yerine getiren ya da dinsel gelenek uyarınca uygulanan kesim töreninden geçen kişiye verilen tarihsel bir dinî nitelemedir. Putlardan uzaklaşıp ibadete yönelme de kaynaklarda bu nitelemeyle ilişkilendirilir.

facets.statement: Kutsal evi ziyaret etme ibadetini yerine getiren kişiye bu dinî nitelemenin verilmesi temel kullanımdır.
Dinsel kesim töreninden geçmiş kişiye aynı nitelemenin verilmesi, kaynakların aktardığı ikinci ölçüttür.
Putlardan uzaklaşıp kendini ibadete verme, nitelemeyle ilişkilendirilen bir davranış olarak aktarılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar nitelemeyi kişiye bağlar; kutsal ziyaret ve dinsel kesim töreni başlıca ölçütlerdir, putlardan uzaklaşarak ibadete yönelme ise ilişkili davranış olarak anılır.

concept_gloss.text: kutsal ziyareti yapan ya da dinsel kesim töreninden geçen kişi

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nitelemenin özellikle bedensel dinî törene dayandığı tarihsel açıklamalarda uygundur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bunlar ya ilişkili dinî sahnenin nesnelerini ve hareketlerini ya da yalnızca sesçe karışabilecek uzak anlamları gösterir. Hiçbiri dalın kişi ve tören ölçütü sınırını yararlı bir yakın karşılaştırmayla keskinleştirmez.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إطلاق حنيف على الحج والاختتان وما ألحقته المصادر بملة إبراهيم من التعبد
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه كل استعمال ديني عام للحنيف ولا أسماء المواضع والأعيان

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, İslam'a yakın zamanda girmiş ve eskiye uzanan geçmişi bulunmayan soyu belirli bir kalıp içinde açıkça tanımlar. Verilen dal çerçevesi hem yenilik hem de köklü geçmiş yokluğu şartlarını doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız belirli soy nitelemesi içinde geçerlidir; genel olarak yeni kişi, yeni kuşak veya kabile adı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca belirli soy nitelemesi kalıbına bağlıdır; buradaki 'yeni' değeri yalın köke veya başka kişi ve topluluk adlarına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yalnızca belirli bir soy nitelemesi kalıbında, İslam'a yakın zamanda girmiş ve eskiye uzanan köklü geçmişi bulunmayan aile kökenini anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir soyun İslam'a yakın zamanda katılmış olması ve eski bir geçmişe dayanmaması birlikte kurucu anlamı oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak açıklaması, yakın zamandaki İslam bağlılığını eski ve köklü bir soy geçmişinin bulunmamasıyla birleştiren aile kökeni nitelemesidir.

concept_gloss.text: İslam'a yeni girmiş, eski geçmişi olmayan soy
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız belirli soy nitelemesi içinde hem yeni din bağlılığını hem de eskiye uzanan geçmiş yokluğunu birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Soy odağını, yakın zamandaki İslam bağlılığını ve eski geçmiş yokluğunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yakın zamandaki din değişiminin aile veya soy niteliği olarak öne çıktığı cümlelerde kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Yeni din bağlılığını ve aile kökeni odağını korur.
error_profile.loses: Eskiye uzanan köklü geçmişin bulunmadığını açıkça belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nitelemenin eskiye dayanmama yönünün özellikle açıklanması gereken bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Soy odağını ve eski bir geçmişe dayanmama koşulunu korur.
error_profile.loses: İslam'a yakın zamanda katılma koşulunu tek başına bildirmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: İslam'a yeni girmiş, eski geçmişi olmayan soy

error_profile.preserves: Soyun yakın zamanda ortaya çıkmış görünmesini korur.
error_profile.adds: Din değişimiyle ilgisi olmayan her türlü yeni aile kolunu veya nesli kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Yeni kurulmuş aile kolu ya da genç kuşak anlamıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişiyi veya şeyi belirli bir topluluk, aile ya da kabile adına bağlayan genel mensubiyet biçimidir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli dinî yenilik ve geçmiş yokluğu koşullarını birlikte ister; komşu dal yalnızca bir topluluğa mensubiyet kurar ve soyun yeni ya da eski oluşunu söylemez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ailenin dinî bağlılığının yeni, geçmişinin ise köksüz oluşunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir topluluktaki gençleri, yeni yetişenleri veya sonradan eklenen çocukları anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir topluluk içindeki yenilik ve kuşaklaşma düşüncesine yaklaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kişilerin yaşını değil soyun dinî ve tarihsel durumunu niteler; komşu dal ise genç veya yeni yetişen insanları ve çocukları adlandırır.
